agents.name: OpenCode
agents.note: Free and open source. For local models it needs an opencode.json that lists them (the button below writes one for Ollama). Models are written provider/model, for example ollama/gemma4:26b.

agents.name: Qwen Code
agents.note: Free and open source. Point it at a local model through its own settings, for example an OpenAI-compatible Ollama endpoint.

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.note: Built for Anthropic's cloud models, so it needs internet and an account. Models are names such as sonnet or opus.

agents.name: Other agent (type the command)
agents.note: Write the command that starts your agent with a first message. {message} is that message, {prompt_file} is the path of the brief, and [--model {model}] is a model option that is left out when no model is chosen.
